note: Live suites for scripts/ai-answer-benchmark.ts --live --live-suite <name>. Question ids only: the questions themselves live in questions.json (v1, never edited) and questions-v2.json. Keeping the SETS here rather than in a flag means a live run is reproducible from a name, and the cost of each one is a number somebody chose rather than a number somebody typed.

smoke.description: The 14 questions a weekly run puts to the real model. One per property that only a live model can show — an answer that finishes, a citation form the parser must read, a refusal that stays a refusal — across both languages and both fixtures. Budgeted: about 9 model calls and 15k tokens.

regression.description: Every question that a previous live run found something on, plus the ones closest to a boundary. This is the set to run after a change to the prompt, the output budget, the citation parser or the provider.
